rules.rule: Receipt matching requires actual shipped production, factory, positive PO allocation, valid style and immutable receipt audit; supplier reminder pilot is not a prerequisite.
rules.initialization: Append0291 replaces only current receipt guard; manifest and owner permission inventory match checksum. No old migration edit, receipt backfill, quantity alteration or pilot default changes.
rules.dateAndPermission: Warehouse capability, cutoff/shipment date, factoryDecisionId audit, same-source PO allocation, exclusions and immutable history retained. Pilot toggles continue to control risk projection and Root-only settings.
rules.expectation: Absent/false/true pilot states support valid direct/automatic receipt links, concurrent toggle and replay. Ambiguous/wrong factory, unshipped and excluded sources stay rejected/unlinked. Existing risk recipient and alert tests remain applicable.

rules.rule: Root directly manages production risk reminders in management settings using existing panel UI, with no duplicate entry or second navigation; no extra role receives access.

rules.initialization: Existing pilots API/table stay compatible; new root-only tab mounts settings content directly, not a separate page/disclosure. Original dashboard exclusion control remains.
rules.dateAndPermission: Authenticated session Root gates navigation; service revalidates Root on reads/writes. PMC keeps original tabs/read-only behavior and gets403 from reminder endpoint.
rules.expectation: Real original App opens settings directly, toggles persist and refresh, fits1165px and hides/refuses PMC. Other settings/calculator/customer and keyboard paths remain functional.
